title: Consensus Transcriptional Landscape of Human End-Stage Heart Failure.
authors: Ramirez Flores, Ricardo O; Lanzer, Jan D; Holland, Christian H; Leuschner, Florian; Most, Patrick; Schultz, Jobst-Hendrik; Levinson, Rebecca T; Saez-Rodriguez, Julio
journal: Journal of the American Heart Association
one_liner_zh: 该文整合人类终末期心衰转录组数据并推断转录因子活性，但核心是疾病转录特征而非TF-DNA结合互作建模，方法上仅用机器学习分类与富集分析，缺乏AI/物理模拟的互作机制研究。
abstract: Background Transcriptomic studies have contributed to fundamental knowledge of myocardial remodeling in human heart failure (HF). However, the key HF genes reported are often inconsistent between studies, and systematic efforts to integrate evidence from multiple patient cohorts are lacking. Here, we aimed to provide a framework for comprehensive comparison and analysis of publicly available data sets resulting in an unbiased consensus transcriptional signature of human end-stage HF. Methods and Results We curated and uniformly processed 16 public transcriptomic studies of left ventricular samples from 263 healthy and 653 failing human hearts. First, we evaluated the degree of consistency between studies by using linear classifiers and overrepresentation analysis. Then, we meta-analyzed the deregulation of 14 041 genes to extract a consensus signature of HF. Finally, to functionally characterize this signature, we estimated the activities of 343 transcription factors, 14 signaling pathways, and 182 micro RNAs, as well as the enrichment of 5998 biological processes. Machine learning approaches revealed conserved disease patterns across all studies independent of technical differences. These consistent molecular changes were prioritized with a meta-analysis, functionally characterized and validated on external data. We provide all results in a free public resource (https://saezlab.shinyapps.io/reheat/) and exemplified usage by deciphering fetal gene reprogramming and tracing the potential myocardial origin of the plasma proteome markers in patients with HF. Conclusions Even though technical and sampling variability confound the identification of differentially expressed genes in individual studies, we demonstrated that coordinated molecular responses during end-stage HF are conserved. The presented resource is crucial to complement findings in independent studies and decipher fundamental changes in failing myocardium.
abstract_zh: 背景 转录组学研究已为人类心力衰竭（HF）中心肌重塑的基础知识作出贡献。然而，所报道的关键HF基因在不同研究间常不一致，且缺乏系统性整合多个患者队列证据的工作。在此，我们旨在提供一个框架，用于全面比较和分析公开数据集，从而得出人类终末期HF的无偏共识转录特征。方法与结果 我们整理并统一处理了来自263个健康及653个衰竭人类心脏左心室样本的16项公共转录组学研究。首先，我们通过线性分类器和过表达分析评估研究间的一致性程度。随后，我们对14,041个基因的失调进行荟萃分析，以提取HF的共识特征。最后，为功能表征该特征，我们估计了343个转录因子、14条信号通路和182个微小RNA的活性，以及5,998个生物学过程的富集情况。机器学习方法揭示了所有研究中独立于技术差异的保守疾病模式。这些一致的分子变化通过荟萃分析优先排序，在外部数据上进行功能表征和验证。我们在免费公共资源中提供所有结果（https://saezlab.shinyapps.io/reheat/），并通过解析胎儿基因重编程和追踪HF患者血浆蛋白质组标志物的潜在心肌起源来示例其使用。结论 尽管技术和采样变异性混淆了个体研究中差异表达基因的识别，但我们证明终末期HF期间的协调分子反应是保守的。所呈现的资源对于补充独立研究中的发现及解析衰竭心肌的基本变化至关重要。
